title_zh: 约定敏感口述历史采访的边界

scenario.label_zh: 约定敏感口述历史采访的边界
scenario.goal_zh: 承认受访者可以不谈创伤经历并约定预先分享问题并允许随时暂停

context_zh: 采访课程的虚构角色练习。两名成年人准备采访一位虚构的创伤经历者，只讨论知情参与和沟通边界。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Our outline asks about the period of imprisonment. Do we really need a question about torture?

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: No. We shouldn't assume someone wants to describe that trauma for our project.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Especially if the interview could leave them feeling vulnerable.

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Let's send the questions first and say they can remove any of them.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: And we'll make clear that they can pause or stop, with no explanation required.

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll add those choices to the invitation before we send it.
